messages:
Olivia Park: Quick weekly check-in on Acme Co caching + batching metrics. Snapshot: hit rate up from 22% -> 44% WoW, avg batch_size 3.2 -> 4.1, cost per 1k tokens $0.78 -> $0.62. Posting numbers and asking if anyone sees odd signals or risks. @Rajesh can you peek at infra during the morning spike?

cs-bot: Automon: detected a transient drop in batch_size and increase in 429s between 1799994000-1799994100. 3 related throttling events.

Rajesh Patel: Looking now. I see an autoscale cooldown and 2 pod restarts in that window — worker churn caused request fanout and smaller batches. Noticed queue latency briefly spiked. Will correlate with deploys.

Miguel Rivera: Thanks. On the cost side, most of the delta is from higher hit rate + switching reranker to 4-bit for ~30% of traffic. Quick calc for transparency:
```
# rough per-1k tokens econ
baseline_cost = 0.95  # $ per 1k tokens
new_cost = baseline_cost * (1 - 0.18)  # 18% savings from hitrate+quant
print(new_cost)  # ~0.78
```
Numbers line up with Olivia's report.

Olivia Park: Can we set a concrete goal: target hit rate >=50% next week and keep avg batch_size >=4? If yes, what are the action items?

Rajesh Patel: Action items I propose:
• increase cache TTL for stable prompt templates from 30m -> 2h (reduces repeated upstream calls)
• bump batching window for web-tier from 20ms -> 40ms (trades a little latency for better batching)
• enable short burst capacity between 09:00-11:00 PST to avoid autoscale cooldowns
I'll canary the batching/window change tonight on 5% traffic.

Sara Kim: I'll draft the enablement note for the customer PMs — call out that TTL change may cause slightly stale responses for template-based prompts. Also update the dashboard widget for "cached responses" so CS can see real-time hit rate.

Miguel Rivera: FYI on stale impact: with TTL 2h we estimate user-visible staleness ~0.5% for prompt templates that change rarely. Recommend tagging cached responses so downstream apps can act if they need fresh answers.

Olivia Park: Good. @cs-bot please add a follow-up reminder to re-check hit rate and avg batch size in 7 days and post canary logs here when ready.

cs-bot: Reminder created: "Re-check Acme Co hit rate + batch metrics" scheduled for 7 days.

Rajesh Patel: Canary deploy scheduled in ~30m. I'll paste canary logs here after rollout.

Olivia Park: 👍 thanks everyone. Will capture these actions in the weekly playbook and ping customer with expected improvements.
